description: This file defines the API for a 'strvec' structure, which allows dynamic management of NULL-terminated string arrays, including functions for initialization, pushing, inserting, removing, splitting, clearing, and detaching strings. It provides mechanisms to build string vectors suitable for command-line argument passing.

methods.name: strvec_init
methods.description: Initializes a `strvec` structure, setting its internal array to an initial state.

methods.name: strvec_push
methods.description: Adds a copy of a string to the end of the vector.

methods.name: strvec_push_nodup
methods.description: Adds a string to the vector, taking ownership of the provided string pointer.

methods.name: strvec_pushf
methods.description: Formats a string with printf-style arguments and adds it to the vector.

methods.name: strvec_pushl
methods.description: Adds multiple strings to the vector; arguments are NULL-terminated.

methods.name: strvec_pushv
methods.description: Adds an array of strings to the vector.

methods.name: strvec_splice
methods.description: Replaces a segment of the vector with new strings, allowing insertion or deletion.

methods.name: strvec_replace
methods.description: Replaces the string at a specified index.

methods.name: strvec_remove
methods.description: Removes the string at a specified index.

methods.name: strvec_pop
methods.description: Removes the last element from the vector.

methods.name: strvec_split
methods.description: Splits a string into tokens (whitespace-separated) and adds them to the vector.

methods.name: strvec_clear
methods.description: Frees all memory associated with the vector and resets it.

methods.name: strvec_detach
methods.description: Detaches the internal array for external management, returning the array pointer.
